rows.label: Points/Game
rows.description: Average points scored per game.

rows.label: Points Allowed/Game
rows.description: Average points allowed per game.

rows.label: Yards/Play (Def)
rows.description: Yards allowed per opponent scrimmage play.

rows.label: Net EPA/Play
rows.description: Offensive EPA per play minus the EPA per play the defence allows. The single best play-by-play summary of how much better a team is than its opponents: it credits a dominant defence as much as a prolific offence and cannot be inflated by pace.

rows.label: Net Yards/Play
rows.description: Offensive yards per play minus defensive yards per play allowed.

rows.description: Rushing yards per game.

rows.description: Rushing yards allowed per game.

rows.description: Rushing yards per rushing attempt.

rows.label: Opp Yards/Rush
rows.description: Rushing yards allowed per opponent attempt.

rows.label: Pass Yds/Game
rows.description: Net passing yards per game.

rows.label: Opp Pass Yds/Game
rows.description: Net passing yards allowed per game.

rows.label: Yards/Pass Att
rows.description: Net passing yards per pass attempt.

rows.label: Opp Yards/Pass Att

rows.label: Sack Rate Allowed

rows.description: Turnovers forced per game.

rows.label: INT Rate
rows.description: Interceptions thrown per pass attempt.

rows.label: Fumble Rate
rows.description: Fumbles lost per offensive play.

rows.label: Offensive EPA/Play
rows.description: Expected points added per play (CFB: CFBD PPA; NFL: nflfastR EPA).

rows.label: Offensive Passing EPA/Play
rows.description: EPA per pass play.

rows.label: Offensive Rushing EPA/Play
rows.description: Expected points added per rushing play.

rows.label: Offensive Early-Down EPA
rows.description: EPA per play on 1st and 2nd down.

rows.label: Offensive Late-Down EPA

rows.label: Defensive Passing EPA/Play
rows.description: EPA per pass play allowed.

rows.label: Defensive Rushing EPA/Play
rows.description: Expected points added per rushing play allowed.

rows.label: Defensive Early-Down EPA
rows.description: EPA per play on 1st and 2nd down allowed.

rows.label: Defensive Late-Down EPA
rows.description: EPA per play on 3rd and 4th down allowed.

rows.label: Defensive Success Rate
rows.description: Share of plays allowed meeting the success yardage threshold (NFL: EPA>0).

rows.label: Defensive Passing Success
rows.description: Success rate on pass plays allowed.

rows.label: Defensive Rushing Success
rows.description: Success rate on rushes allowed.

rows.label: Defensive Standard-Down Success
rows.description: Success rate on standard downs allowed.

rows.label: Defensive Passing-Down Success
rows.description: Success rate on passing downs allowed.

rows.label: Defensive Explosiveness
rows.description: Average EPA on successful plays allowed (IsoPPP-style).

rows.label: Explosive Play Rate
rows.description: Share of plays gaining 10+ rushing or 20+ passing yards.

rows.description: Share of opponent plays gaining 10+ rushing or 20+ passing yards.

rows.description: Share of rushes gaining 10+ yards.

rows.label: 20+ Yard Pass Rate
rows.description: Share of dropbacks producing a 20+ yard completion.

rows.label: Points/Scoring Opportunity
rows.description: Points per drive that reached the opponent 40.

rows.label: Points Allowed/Scoring Opp
rows.description: Points allowed per opponent drive reaching your 40.

rows.label: TD Rate in Opp Territory
rows.description: Touchdowns per drive that reached the opponent 40.

rows.label: Avg Starting Field Position
rows.description: Average own-yardline where offensive drives start.

rows.label: Opp Avg Starting Field Position
rows.description: Average own-yardline where opponent drives start.

rows.label: Plays/Game
rows.description: Offensive scrimmage plays per game.

rows.label: Seconds/Play
rows.description: Average seconds between offensive snaps within a drive (lower = faster pace).

rows.label: Neutral-Script Seconds/Play
rows.description: Seconds per play when the score is within 8 in the first three quarters (lower = faster pace).

rows.label: Pass Rate
rows.description: Dropbacks per scrimmage play.

rows.label: Early-Down Pass Rate
rows.description: Dropbacks per play on 1st and 2nd down.

rows.label: Neutral-Script Pass Rate
rows.description: Dropbacks per play when the game is within 8 points in the first three quarters.

rows.label: Avg FG Distance
rows.description: Average field-goal attempt distance in yards.

quick_look.edge_rule: An edge is credited when the two teams differ by at least 12 percentile points on that metric. The ESPN rank rows are shown for context and are not counted: they are composites of the same evidence the rows above already measure.
